invalidBaseUrl.zh-CN: Cloudflare baseUrl 必须是无凭证、查询参数或片段的 HTTPS URL；仅本机测试允许 HTTP。
invalidBaseUrl.en-US: Cloudflare baseUrl must be an HTTPS URL without credentials, query, or fragment; HTTP is allowed only for loopback tests.

invalidModel.zh-CN: Cloudflare 模型必须为 clef-flash 或 clef。
invalidModel.en-US: Cloudflare model must be clef-flash or clef.

invalidEnvName.zh-CN: Cloudflare 环境变量名格式不正确。

missingAccountId.zh-CN: 没有找到 Cloudflare accountId；请配置 accountId 或由运行层注入 accountIdEnv 指定的环境变量（默认 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID）。
missingAccountId.en-US: No Cloudflare account ID found; configure accountId or supply the variable named by accountIdEnv (default CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID).

invalidAccountId.zh-CN: Cloudflare accountId 必须是 32 位十六进制标识。
invalidAccountId.en-US: Cloudflare accountId must be a 32-character hexadecimal ID.

missingToken.zh-CN: 没有找到 Cloudflare API token；请由可信运行层注入 tokenEnv 指定的环境变量（默认 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN）。
missingToken.en-US: No Cloudflare API token found; have the trusted launcher supply the variable named by tokenEnv (default CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).

timeout.zh-CN: Cloudflare 审查超时（所有批次与重试共用预算）。
timeout.en-US: Cloudflare review timed out (all batches and retries share one budget).

aborted.zh-CN: 上级请求已终止，Cloudflare 请求已取消。
aborted.en-US: The parent request was aborted, so the Cloudflare request was cancelled.

networkFailed.zh-CN: Cloudflare 请求无法建立连接，重试次数已用尽。
networkFailed.en-US: The Cloudflare request could not reach the service; retries were exhausted.

invalidQuestions.zh-CN: Cloudflare 审查需要至少一个 Noul 或 Choice 问题。
invalidQuestions.en-US: Cloudflare review requires at least one Noul or Choice question.

responseTooLarge.zh-CN: Cloudflare 响应超过 1 MiB 上限。
responseTooLarge.en-US: The Cloudflare response exceeds the 1 MiB limit.

invalidResponse.zh-CN: Cloudflare 响应不是有效 JSON 或缺少预期的 result/answers/model。
invalidResponse.en-US: The Cloudflare response is invalid JSON or has unexpected result/answers/model fields.

invalidAnswer.zh-CN: Cloudflare 响应缺少答案，或答案 ID、类型、概率或 Choice 候选不合法。
invalidAnswer.en-US: Cloudflare answers are missing or have invalid IDs, types, probabilities, or Choice candidates.

authenticationRejected.zh-CN: 鉴权或账号权限被拒绝。
authenticationRejected.en-US: Authentication or account permission was denied.

regionRejected.zh-CN: 服务拒绝该地区的请求。
regionRejected.en-US: The service denied the request from this region.

inputRejected.zh-CN: 服务拒绝请求参数或模型输入。
inputRejected.en-US: The service rejected the request parameters or model input.

redirectRejected.zh-CN: 已拒绝重定向，未向目标发送凭证。
redirectRejected.en-US: The redirect was rejected; credentials were not sent to its target.

serviceRejected.en-US: The service returned a failure result.
